name: Chess Crawler
author: Micherman
description: Logical chess-like game where player has to move a white piece to the end of each level. Avoid or destroy enemies but do not take too much time - chessboard is gradually falling apart. Buy Chess Crawler for Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.MichermanStudios.ChessCrawler ; See gameplay video: https://youtu.be/t7GGHP-ZYOI
